name: range_day_band_fade_003_5s
author: adapted from cursor-fast
thesis: This strategy exploits overreaction inside intraday range regimes where price moves too far from fair value without broad directional sponsorship. The inefficiency exists because many traders mechanically chase local strength or weakness even when the tape is rotational, and it persists because the edge vanishes on trend days.
mechanism: VWAP is the institutional execution benchmark. When spot deviates significantly from session VWAP, algorithmic execution engines increase order flow to mean-revert their fills toward VWAP. This creates measurable gravitational pull, especially during lower-volume mid-session periods when fewer competing flows are present.

exit.signal_exit: exit when adx_14 rises above 24 OR close crosses vwap

weaknesses: Performance is regime-dependent and weakens materially when session structure changes mid-trade.
Fast moves can create worse-than-assumed slippage and reduce realized edge versus paper assumptions.
Crowding risk can compress payoff and make execution quality unstable in the most obvious setups.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
